findings.description: The exact required transaction_owner_regressions_pass command exits 1 (1 failed, 57 passed). Its existing negative fixture moves RUNNING INTENT to 2026-09-27, where RUNNING INTENT_2 already owns the same subject/date/purpose partition. The new frozen-S27 unique index correctly rejects the fixture before the intended Reauthorize head-day rejection and remaining atomic-success assertions execute. findings.title: Typed planning replay omits the frozen historical-result marker
findings.description: The new typed AdmitOrReviseIntent/AcquireLease/RenewLease API returns replay_outcome's raw durable mapping on its preflight path and planning_historical_outcome's raw mapping on the under-S01 race path. replay_outcome adds replayed=true only for dispatch/session commands, while the service also discards idempotent_outcome's replay boolean. Consequently a repeated acquire returns the original owner/fence/expiry with exactly the same response shape as a fresh acquisition even after cancellation or request revision; tests/db/test_planning.py explicitly asserts this mapping equality. Frozen DB section 3 requires same-key/same-payload replay to identify replayed=true. Current fence guards still deny stale mutations, so this finding is a response-contract violation, not evidence that historical replay bypasses those guards.
findings.required_action: Expose replayed=true for every historical planning result, including both replay paths and any idempotent receipt replay, while retaining original entity identities and performing no lease/intent mutation. Update tests and the planning contract to distinguish replay metadata from durable result identity, including replay after revision/takeover/terminal state. A task-local response adaptation can satisfy the frozen contract without changing frozen authority.

observations: Independent review inspected the protected-base implementation/result diff, planning domain/service, every transaction-owner change, additive migration, test oracles, final raw evidence and result. The tested-to-reviewed suffix changes only task result/evidence; application, migration, tests and contract bytes remain those of tested_commit.

Deterministic normalization separates partition and semantic fingerprint, preserves ordered collections, handles NFC/trim/equipment set semantics, rejects ambiguous types/key collisions and binds S28 to the normalization version. Same calendar/fingerprint/current Manifest/epoch/frontier basis joins without S27/S28/S29 mutation or quota debit.

Revision appends the next immutable S28 and CREATED S29, marks only the locked old current S29 STALE and atomically switches current pointers. Prepared T4 capability guards preserve deadline, root limits, reserved/settled categories, stale restart count, owner and fence; returning to prior constraints creates a new revision. Root admission debits policy-bound hourly/daily S30 quotas with intent/request/attempt/receipt/event/outbox in one owner transaction. Full downstream call-budget enforcement remains outside this packet.

The new partial index implements frozen ADMITTED/RUNNING uniqueness and explicitly includes legacy PENDING as ADMITTED compatibility; new service roots write ADMITTED. Terminal intent meanings are distinct, generic FAILED is rejected as an intent terminal substitute, terminal attempts deny typed lease commands and cannot be revived through revision.

Acquire proves exact prior owner/fence/request/current attempt, increments fencing and persists future deadline-bounded expiry. Renew uses trusted post-lock time, exact live owner/token/request/attempt, strict expiry extension and deadline cap. Both retain S27-only mutation and lock capabilities; no generic S29 capability was granted. Shared current-fence guard additionally rejects frozen terminal attempts while preserving merged nonterminal compatibility.

S01 precedes stable S30 keys, S27, S02 and remaining S29. Coordination methods perform no external model/network wait. Tests contain bounded PostgreSQL-observed contention for acquisition/takeover and renewal post-lock rereads, persisted-state revision invalidation and injected rollback; this review did not run a database or Docker lifecycle.

T6 remains the only successful prescription/authorization owner. The new code does not write S38/S42/S45, enable production auto-activation, admit EVALUATION identities, or let provider evidence act as command authority. Trusted SUBJECT/TEST identity and persisted namespace checks preserve the existing production/shadow boundary. Planning tests use synthetic isolated TEST subjects; they make no W04-W06/product/release PASS claim.

Final committed evidence records twelve passing exact checks, including 2 planning unit cases, 6 migrated planning cases and 26 migration cases, plus the failed owner regression above. Independently reran .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/unit/workflow/test_planning.py: 2 passed, no skips/deselection. The exact uv command could not be rerun in this reviewer shell because uv is absent from PATH; the committed exact-command evidence was inspected. No independent database execution was performed.

Frozen authorities, historical migrations, requirement statuses and baseline metadata remain unchanged. M2 closure is PASS and KL-015 integration is MERGED. BLOCKED task state is recorded honestly; no merge recommendation is made. Neither finding requests a frozen semantics change. Substantive repairs require a new result/evidence revision and fresh independent reviews.
